data.standardized_narrative: Gross prior-year reserves moved adverse by approximately GBP 12.8m (strengthening) when measured on a gross claims development basis (older underwriting years up to 2015). This adverse movement was driven by deterioration in certain Liability and Accident & Health exposures and adverse development in some 2014/2015 years, partially offset by favourable development (releases) in Property, Marine and Credit & Political Risk. Net of reinsurance the Syndicate reports a small release of GBP 0.8m for prior years, reflecting significant reinsurance recoverables and the effect of reinsurance programmes that largely functioned for the 2017 catastrophe activity (Hurricanes Harvey/Irma/Maria and California wildfires).
raw_causal_phrases: 2017 was a year marked by an exceptional series of large natural catastrophe losses including Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria (HIM) in the U.S. and the Caribbean, and wildfires in California.

These catastrophe losses were compounded by a high frequency of large losses during 2017 but despite this elevated level of activity, the property account did benefit from a release of reserves during the financial year.
We strengthened reserves for two specific large claims on the Financial Institutions part of our Liability account during 2017 following the market wide FCA review into annuity sales.
We had a reserve release on our Credit and Political Risk account following favourable development in the year.
Across all classes combined we had a net reserve release of GBP 0.8m.
Overall on an aggregate basis, reserve releases of GBP 0.8m net of reinsurance were made to prior year reserves during 2017. In 2016 there was a reserve release of GBP 1.4m.

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior-year development was not stated explicitly as a single gross figure in the movement notes or narrative. The gross prior-year movement here (12.802m adverse) is calculated from the gross claims development triangle (pages 36). The report explicitly states a NET prior-year release of GBP 0.8m (net of reinsurance) - that net figure is different from the gross triangle-derived movement. No per-event gross amounts were provided for named catastrophes. All triangle values are presented in GBP '000 in the report and converted to millions here.
